DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談先とは画面がつながりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Has the video connection to the consultation service been established?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 画面は見えますが、相手の声が聞こえません。こちらの声は届いているそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: オンライン相談で映像は見えるが相手の声が聞こえないと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can see the picture, but I cannot hear the other person. They say they can hear my voice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you can see the online consultation video but cannot hear the other person. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 机のヘッドセットをお使いですね。音量のつまみを見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You are using the headset on the desk. I will look at the volume knob.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: つまみが一番小さくなっています。少し上げてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ヘッドセット音量の低さに気づき調整する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The knob is at its lowest setting. I will turn it up a little.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Notice the low headset volume and adjust it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その位置で、相手の方へ声を出していただきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us ask the other person to speak with it at that setting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今は聞こえます。大きすぎない音になりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 聞こえる適切な音量になったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can hear now. The volume is suitable and not too loud.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you can hear at a suitable volume. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: よかったです。相談の資料は、こちらの書類カメラで見せられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Good. You can show your consultation documents with this document camera.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この一枚を見せたいです。紙を横向きに置くと全部映りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 書類カメラへ資料を横向きに置く方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to show this sheet. If I place the paper sideways, will all of it appear?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about placing the document sideways under the document camera. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、横にすると収まります。画面で文字の向きも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, it will fit sideways. Please also check the direction of the writing on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全体が映っています。音も資料も大丈夫なので、このまま相談を始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料全体と音を確認し相談を開始する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: The whole sheet is visible. Both the sound and the document are fine, so I will start the consultation like this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the whole document and sound, then start the consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、職員は退室します。終わりましたら呼出しをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: The staff will leave the room, then. Please call us when you have finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 退院後の説明で、気になる所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything in the post-discharge instructions you are concerned about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 薬は昼食後と書いてありますが、仕事の日は昼食が二時になります。時刻をどうしたらいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昼食後服薬と仕事日の二時昼食の関係を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says to take the medicine after lunch, but on workdays I eat lunch at two. What should I do about the time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about after-lunch medication when lunch on workdays is at two. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 薬の種類を確認して、薬剤師へおつなぎします。普段の食事の時刻も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the type of medicine and connect you with the pharmacist. I will also ask your usual mealtimes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝は七時、夜は八時です。休みの日の昼食は十二時です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 朝夜と休日昼食の時刻を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Breakfast is at seven and dinner at eight. On days off, lunch is at twelve.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State your morning and evening mealtimes and lunchtime on days off. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 仕事の日と休みの日で昼食の時刻が違うのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: So your lunchtime differs between workdays and days off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。朝の薬と近くなるか心配なので、自分で昼の薬を朝へ移すつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己変更せず朝薬との間隔を心配していると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I worry it might be too close to my morning medicine, so I do not intend to move the lunchtime medicine to the morning myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not change it yourself and are concerned about the interval from the morning medicine. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのご心配も伝えます。説明のメモに、二通りの生活時間を書きましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass on that concern too. Let us write the two daily schedules in the instruction notes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この余白に「仕事の日、昼食二時」と書きます。休みの日は十二時と書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仕事日休日の二つの昼食時刻をメモする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write “workday, lunch at two” in this margin. For days off, I will write twelve.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Note the two lunchtimes for workdays and days off. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 薬剤師が今こちらへ来ますので、そのメモをお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The pharmacist is coming here now, so please show that note.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。説明を聞いたら、飲む時刻をメモへ追加して持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 薬剤師説明後に服薬時刻を追記して持ち帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. After hearing the explanation, I will add the time to take the medicine to the note and take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After the pharmacist's explanation, add the medication time and take the note home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、この席でご相談ください。退院準備でお疲れのところ、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please consult them at this seat. Excuse me for disturbing you while you are tired from preparing for discharge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 請求のメールを受け取ったのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You received an email demanding payment, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。注文していない商品について、今日中に払うよう書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未注文商品の当日支払請求メールを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It says to pay by the end of today for a product I did not order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the email demanding same-day payment for an unordered product. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メールの中のリンクを開いたり、支払ったりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you opened a link in the email or paid anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どちらもしていません。送信元の名前は、以前使った店と似ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: リンク未開封支払なしと似た送信者名を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Neither. The sender's name resembles a shop I have used before.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not opened a link or paid and that the sender's name looks similar. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受信した画面と、文面を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you show the received email screen and its wording?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。注文番号はありますが、その番号の注文は自分の購入履歴にありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: メールを見せ購入履歴に該当注文がないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. There is an order number, but I have no order with that number in my purchase history.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the email and that there is no corresponding order in your purchase history. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 添付ファイルは開いていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 開いていません。店の正規の問い合わせ先へ確認する前に、相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 添付未開封と正規連絡先への確認前の相談を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not. I came for advice before checking through the shop's official contact details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have not opened attachments and are consulting before checking with the official contact. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 送信元やリンク先は、専門の担当が確認します。文面は残しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The specialist staff will check the sender and link destinations. Please keep the message text.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 消さずに残します。追加でメールが来たら、同じ画面と受信時刻を記録しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メール保存と追加受信時刻記録を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep it without deleting it. If more emails arrive, I will record the same screen and the time received.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to preserve the email and record additional receipt times. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will guide you to the staff in charge. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ポストへの投函についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about putting a letter in the postbox?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。今日中に出したい手紙ですが、表のポストは最後の集荷が終わっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 当日差出し希望とポスト最終集荷後かを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to post this letter today. Has the last collection from the postbox outside already finished?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to post today and ask whether the last collection is over. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日はそのポストの集荷は終わりました。窓口はまだ受け付けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Collection from that box has finished for today. The counter is still accepting mail.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、窓口へ出します。貼った切手のままで預かってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 窓口差出しへ変え貼付切手の利用を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will hand it in at the counter. Can you accept it with the stamp already attached?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Switch to counter posting and check whether the attached stamp can be used. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 重さと料金を確認します。こちらの切手で足りています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the weight and postage. That stamp is enough.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 助かりました。今日受け付けてもらえれば、明日必ず着くということではありませんよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 当日受付と翌日到着の違いを確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: That helps. Acceptance today does not mean it will definitely arrive tomorrow, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the difference between same-day acceptance and next-day arrival. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、到着日は別にご案内します。お急ぎの内容ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Correct; we will advise the arrival date separately. Is the letter urgent?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 急ぎではありません。出し忘れないよう、今日のうちに差し出したかっただけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 急ぎではなく出し忘れ防止の当日差出しと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is not urgent. I just wanted to post it today so I would not forget.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain it is not urgent and you only want to post today to avoid forgetting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それでしたら、普通の送り方でお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: In that case, we will accept it as ordinary mail.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。同行者には、窓口へ出したので外のポストには入れないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 普通扱いを依頼し同行者へ投函不要を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will tell my companion I have handed it in at the counter, so it must not go in the outside postbox.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request ordinary mail and tell your companion there is no need to put it in the box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確かにお預かりしました。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have received it. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受付の番号を確認されたいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check your queue number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。札をかばんに入れたはずですが、見つかりません。もう一枚取るべきでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 番号札不明で再発行すべきか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I thought I put the slip in my bag, but I cannot find it. Should I take another one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to get a replacement when your queue slip cannot be found. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お取りになった時刻と、用件を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you tell me when you took it and what you are here for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十時ごろです。通帳の繰越しを選びました。番号は八十六だったと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十時の通帳繰越しと推定八十六番を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: About ten. I selected passbook renewal. I think the number was eighty-six.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State passbook renewal at ten and an estimated number eighty-six. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の受付記録には、その時刻に八十六番があります。お名前では管理していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The reception record shows eighty-six at that time. We do not manage it by name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今呼ばれているのは八十四番ですね。二枚取らず、元の順番で待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在八十四番と元の順番を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The number being called now is eighty-four. I would like to wait in my original place without taking two slips.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the current eighty-four and ask to keep your original place. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次に八十六番を呼ぶ時、窓口でお話を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: When eighty-six is called next, we will check what you told us at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。通帳は手元にあります。窓口で、札がないことを先に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通帳を持ち札紛失を窓口で伝えると了承する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I have my passbook. At the counter, I will first explain that I do not have the slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Agree to bring the passbook and tell the counter the slip is missing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: あ、かばんの横のポケットに紙が見えていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Oh, there is some paper visible in your bag's side pocket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありました、八十六番です。札を持って、表示が変わるまで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 横ポケットの八十六番を見つけ番号表示を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Found it, number eighty-six. I will hold the slip and wait until the display changes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Find eighty-six in the side pocket and wait for the number display. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 見つかってよかったです。お呼びするまでお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Good that you found it. Please wait until we call you. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 卵のパックが開いてしまいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Has your carton of eggs opened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。かごへ入れた時、ふたの留める所が外れました。卵は落ちていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: かご入れ時に卵パック留め具が外れ落下なしと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. When I put it in the basket, the part holding the lid shut came loose. The eggs did not fall.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the egg-carton fastening came loose when put in the basket, with no eggs falling. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 卵の状態を確認します。割れている物は見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the eggs. None appear cracked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そのまま買いたいですが、持って歩くとまた開きそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ卵購入を希望し再開封を心配する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to buy these same ones, but it looks as though the carton may open again while I carry it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to buy the same eggs and express concern about reopening. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 留め直して、こちらの紙帯を巻きます。袋へ入れる前に位置を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will fasten it again and wrap this paper band around it. Check its position before putting it in a bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 帯がふたを押さえていますね。値段の表示も見えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紙帯の固定と価格表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The band is holding the lid down. The price label is visible too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the paper band's fastening and visibility of the price. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この状態で会計できます。ほかに重い商品はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can pay with it like this. Do you have other heavy products?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 牛乳を買います。卵とは別の手提げに入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 牛乳と卵を別手提げへ分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will buy milk. I would like to put it in a separate carrier bag from the eggs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want separate carrier bags for the milk and eggs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 紙帯は会計後も付けたままでお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please leave the paper band on after checkout too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。卵用の小さい手提げを出し、牛乳は大きい方へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帯を残し小袋へ卵大袋へ牛乳を入れる準備をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will get out a small bag for the eggs and put the milk in the large one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the band and prepare the eggs for a small bag and the milk for a large one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのままレジへお進みください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to the checkout as it is. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 足こぎカートをご利用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you using a pedal cart?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。座ってみましたが、ペダルの一番遠い所へ足が届きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 足こぎカートのペダルに足が届かないと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I tried sitting in it, but my feet cannot reach the pedals at their furthest point.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that your feet cannot reach the pedal-cart pedals. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 座席を一段前へ動かします。一度降りていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will move the seat one position forward. Could you get out once?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 降りました。荷物も横の台へ置いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 座席調整のため降り荷物を台へ置く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have got out. I will put my belongings on the table beside it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Get out for seat adjustment and put belongings on the table. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 固定しました。もう一度座り、止まったままでペダルを回してみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is locked in place. Sit again and try turning the pedals while staying stationary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今は届きます。膝もハンドルに当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 調整後の到達と膝の接触なしを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can reach now. My knees do not touch the steering wheel either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that you can reach after adjustment and your knees do not touch. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、ブレーキをかける動作も試してください。このレバーです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Now try applying the brake too. It is this lever.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 握ると車輪が止まりますね。走る前に、コースの向きも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 停止中にブレーキ操作を試しコース方向を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Squeezing it stops the wheels. Before setting off, I would also like to ask which way the course goes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Test the brake while stopped and ask the direction of the course. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口から左回りです。一周したら、この停止線の前で止まってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Counterclockwise from the entrance. After one circuit, stop before this stop line.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 左回りで一周し、線の前でブレーキをかけます。この座席位置で始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 左回り一周と停止線前の制動を確認して開始する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will do one circuit counterclockwise and brake before the line. I will start with the seat in this position.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm one counterclockwise circuit and braking before the stop line, then start. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、ゆっくりお進みください。楽しんでくださいね。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次の列車は運休になりました。指定券をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: The next train has been canceled. Do you have a reserved-seat ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。座席を予約してありますが、この券はどうすればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 指定券の運休時の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I have booked a seat. What should I do with this ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what to do with a reserved-seat ticket when the train is canceled. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 変更か払い戻しを、窓口でご相談いただけます。今日中に移動されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can discuss a change or refund at the counter. Will you travel today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日は取りやめます。乗車券と指定席の券が別ですが、両方持って行きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旅行を取りやめ二種類の券の持参を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will cancel today's trip. The travel ticket and reserved-seat ticket are separate. Should I bring both?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Cancel the trip and ask about bringing the two kinds of ticket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、両方お持ちください。お支払いはカードでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, bring both. Did you pay by card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: カードです。使ったカードも鞄にあります。窓口は改札の外ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: カード払いを伝え窓口の位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: By card. The card I used is also in my bag. Is the counter outside the gates?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you paid by card and ask where the counter is. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 外の右側です。まだ改札には入っていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Outside on the right. You have not entered the gates yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、入っていません。同行者の券も私がまとめて買ったので、一緒に持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 改札未入場と同行者分の購入を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Correct. I have not. I bought my companion's tickets together too, so I will bring them as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain you have not entered the gates and bought your companion's tickets too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 購入した際の控えがあれば、それもご用意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you have the receipt from the purchase, prepare that too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 財布に控えがありました。券二人分とカード、控えを持って右の窓口へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 券とカードと控えを揃え窓口へ向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I found the receipt in my wallet. I will take the tickets for two people, the card, and the receipt to the counter on the right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Gather the tickets, card, and receipt and go to the counter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの通路からどうぞ。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use this passage. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談予約の受付です。どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the consultation booking desk. What would you like advice about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 賃貸住宅のことで相談したいです。難しい話になるので、通訳もお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住宅相談で通訳を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to discuss rental housing. It will be complicated, so could I request an interpreter too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for an interpreter for a housing consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 対応できる言語と日程を担当に確認します。何語をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check available languages and dates with the staff in charge. Which language would you prefer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ベトナム語です。仕事が休みの水曜午後なら来られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 言語と来庁可能日時を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Vietnamese. I can come on Wednesday afternoon, when I am off work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the language and when you can come to the office. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 水曜午後の希望で照会します。相談の資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will inquire about Wednesday afternoon. Do you have documents for the consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 契約書と、大家さんから届いた手紙があります。先に写しを送った方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資料を説明し事前送付を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the contract and a letter from my landlord. Should I send copies beforehand?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the documents and ask about sending them ahead. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 予約担当が送付方法をお伝えします。折り返し先を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The booking staff will tell you how to send them. Please give me your callback number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この携帯番号です。午前中は出られないので、午後三時以降にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 折り返し番号と連絡可能時間を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: This mobile number. I cannot answer in the morning, so please call after three in the afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify the callback number and a time you can be reached. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 午後三時以降の連絡と記録しました。日程は折り返しの時に決まります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have noted a call after three. The appointment date will be decided when we call you back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだ予約確定ではないのですね。連絡を受けてから、契約書を用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約未確定を理解し資料準備を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: So the booking is not confirmed yet. After I receive the call, I will prepare the contract.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Understand that the booking is unconfirmed and decide to prepare the documents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ取り次ぎます。お電話ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass this to the staff in charge. Thank you for calling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 退院の書類はそろいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are all your discharge documents ready?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、この紙の入浴の欄に丸が二つあって、どちらなのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 退院書類の入浴欄の不明点を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But there are two circles in the bathing section of this paper, and I do not know which applies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain what is unclear in the discharge document's bathing section. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一緒に拝見します。シャワーと浴槽の欄ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us look together. The shower and bathtub sections, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日からシャワーだけよいという意味ですか。傷があるので、聞き直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: シャワーの可否を担当へ再確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Does it mean only a shower is allowed from today? I have a wound, so I would like to ask again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to reconfirm shower permission with the staff in charge. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当の看護師に記載を確認します。少しこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the entry with the nurse in charge. Please wait here a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。説明の時、着替えの際に傷をぬらした場合も聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 傷をぬらした場合の相談を追加する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. During the explanation, can I also ask what to do if the wound gets wet while changing clothes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Add a question about the wound getting wet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、その点も伝えます。担当が今こちらへ来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, I will pass that on too. The nurse is coming here now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自宅に浴槽しかなくて、どう洗えばよいかも相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自宅の入浴設備を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: At home I only have a bathtub, so I also want advice on how to wash.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain your bathing facilities at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その事情も直接お話しください。指示が決まったら紙へ追記してもらいましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell them that directly too. Once the instructions are decided, let us have them added to the paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。自己判断で入浴せず、担当の説明を聞いてから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当の指示を聞いてから帰ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not bathe on my own judgment, and will go home after hearing the staff's explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to hear the staff's instructions before going home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞこちらのお席へ。退院後もお大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please sit here. Take care of yourself after discharge too.
